ratio_definition: Right hippocampal volume / left hippocampal volume (R/L)
ratio_location: Statistical Analysis, journal p.340; Figure 1, p.341
measurement_method: MIDAS manual thresholding and boundary tracing; not FreeSurfer
anatomical_definition: Hippocampal formation includes dentate gyrus, hippocampus proper, subiculum and alveus (p.340).
method_location: Imaging, p.339; Hippocampal Formation and Cross-Sectional and Longitudinal Measurements, p.340
annualization: Constant proportionate atrophy assumption (p.340); no closed-form annualization equation is printed. Requires serial MRI.
counting_policy: Table 2 has 16 estimates: 12 newly recorded contextual estimates and 4 atrophy estimates already in the six-record abstract extraction. This source-review table is not an additional patient matching/voting pool.
printed_summary_note: Retain the abstract AD baseline asymmetry 1.8% (-1.9, 5.5) separately from the rounded Table 2 baseline R/L ratio 1.019 (0.981, 1.058). They must not overwrite one another or be treated as independent cohort evidence; rounded values do not establish identical aggregation. Control abstract asymmetry summarizes both visits (Results, p.340).
statistical_caution: AD right vs left annual atrophy p=0.05 is described as just failing statistical significance in Results, p.341. R/L change between visits and the group difference in that change have p=0.02 (p.340); neither supplies an individual diagnostic cutoff.
conclusion: Altered right-left asymmetry is not necessarily a reliable AD progression indicator; do not assume the right hippocampus is a superior surrogate marker (Discussion, p.343).
permitted_use: Verified literature context only. MIDAS-to-FreeSurfer anatomical/processing equivalence is not validated; geometric means and mean 95% CIs are not mean/SD individual reference distributions. Annual atrophy requires serial MRI. No single-scan disease probability or patient QC approval follows.
